headline: Original premium and interface icons restored without neighboring-art bleed

changes.title: Remove obsolete artwork and layout regression suites
changes.detail: Deleted assertions that required fixed icon identities, sprite crop pixels, alpha thresholds, atlas coordinates, and button artwork layouts. These tests no longer force old graphics back into the game.

changes.title: Keep gameplay, purchases, saving and navigation under test
changes.detail: Retained checks for real currencies, boosters, aquarium and fishing gameplay, homestead upgrades, campaign progression, overlay mechanics, and save persistence while removing art-specific expectations.

changes.title: Premium economy artwork repaired from untouched source atlases
changes.detail: Restored twenty original premium, currency-package and shop-item illustrations by isolating each sprite's opaque core and antialiased edge. Corrected chopped nut bars, chests, VIP shields, gifts and timers without changing their item identities.

changes.title: Original interface icons restored without crop spillover
changes.detail: Re-exported all twenty-one menu and interface sprites as independent transparent PNGs, including shop, coupon-related icons, settings, navigation and timer. Existing button mappings, spacing and click behavior remain unchanged.
